title: cyperus digitatus var. oatesii
intro: Cyperus digitatus var. oatesii, commonly known as Oates' flatsedge, is a plant species within the sedge family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and treating fever. The health benefits of Oates' flatsedge are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
